section.content: The invention relates to the technical field of electrode binders, in particular to a water-based binder for a lithium ion battery, a preparation method and application thereof, which is formed by copolymerizing at least a modified functional monomer, an propenyl monomer and a crosslinking monomer and has a three-dimensional crosslinking network structure. The invention has high dispersibility, high cohesiveness and high elasticity to electrode active substances and conductive substances, can ensure the structural stability of electrode materials, can buffer the stress generated by the volume expansion and contraction of the active substances, and effectively improves the cycle stability and multiplying power characteristics of the electrode. In addition, the polymer chain segment is rich in dispersibility of inorganic materials, so that layering or floating of inorganic matters can be effectively prevented, and the prepared battery has low impedance. The adhesive has strong adhesion and excellent performance when being used for secondary batteries, is particularly suitable for lithium ion batteries taking silicon base as a negative electrode, and can improve the cycle stability of the silicon base lithium ion batteries.

本发明涉及电极粘结剂技术领域，具体为一种用于锂离子电池的水系粘结剂及其制备方法和应用，至少由改性功能单体以及丙烯基单体、交联单体共聚而成，具有三维交联网状结构。本发明具有对电极活性物质和导电物质具有高分散性、高粘结性、高弹性，可以保证电极材料的结构稳定，同时可缓冲活性物质体积膨胀和收缩产生的应力，有效提升了电极的循环稳定性和倍率特性。另外，因聚合物链段中富含有对无机材料的分散性，可有效阻止无机物的分层或上浮等，所制备的电池阻抗低。该粘结剂的粘结性强，在用于二次电池时性能优异，特别适用于以硅基为负极的锂离子电池，可以提高硅基锂离子电池的循环稳定性。

Water-based binder for lithium ion battery and preparation method and application thereofTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of electrode binders, in particular to a water-based binder for a lithium ion battery, and a preparation method and application thereof.

Background

In recent years, lithium ion batteries are closely related to our lives, are small to portable electronic equipment, and are widely applied to large-scale energy storage systems such as electric automobiles and the like and have wide market value, and the lithium ion batteries nowadays develop towards the directions of prolonged cycle stability, high energy density, high transmission rate capability, low cost and safety. In lithium ion batteries, the binder is an important inactive material, has a low duty ratio, but plays an important role, and plays a role in binding the active material, the conductive agent and the current collector, so that the SEI film is stabilized, and the SEI film has integral connectivity, thereby reducing ion transmission resistance of the electrode, simultaneously enabling the pole piece to have good mechanical property and processing property, and meeting industrial production requirements.

Currently, the binder used for lithium ion battery electrodes is polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF). There are two problems with using PVDF: ① PVDF for lithium ion batteries is mainly imported and is less in domestic production; ② The PVDF is dissolved by N-methyl pyrrolidone, a large amount of solvent is evaporated, a large amount of cost is consumed, and a certain risk exists in using the solvent. In order to solve these problems, there is a need for developing a more environmentally friendly and inexpensive electrode binder for lithium ion batteries.

Although carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC) and polystyrene butadiene copolymer (SBR) binders exhibit good electrochemical performance in graphite negative electrodes, SBR has a large swelling degree and low adhesion for high-silicon-based high-energy density batteries, and cannot be used in negative electrodes of high-energy density batteries.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention provides a water-based binder for a lithium ion battery, a preparation method and application thereof, which have high dispersibility, high cohesiveness and high elasticity on electrode active substances and conductive substances, effectively improve the quality of the electrode, and have lower impedance.

In order to achieve the above purpose, the present invention provides the following technical solutions: the water-based binder for the lithium ion battery is formed by copolymerizing at least a silane modified phosphate monomer and an propenyl monomer, and has a three-dimensional cross-linked network structure, wherein the silane modified phosphate monomer has the following structural formula:

Wherein R 1 is H, Any one of the following.

Preferably, the acryl monomer comprises a basic acryl monomer and a high-elasticity high-toughness monomer; the mass ratio of the silane modified phosphate monomer to the basic propenyl monomer to the high-elasticity high-toughness monomer is (0.5-20): (50-90.5): (5-40).

Preferably, the basic propenyl monomer is any one or more of acrylic acid, methacrylic acid, methyl methacrylate, ethyl methacrylate, acrylonitrile, acrylamide, butyl methacrylate, N-dimethylacrylamide, N-methylenebisacrylamide, glycidyl methacrylate, ethoxytrimethylol propane acrylate, propoxyl trimethylol propane acrylate, triethylene glycol dimethacrylate and itaconic acid.

Preferably, the high-elastic high-toughness monomer is any one or more of isooctyl methacrylate, SW514 (a special monomer of single-functional hard-toughness acrylic acid), 4-tertiary butyl cyclohexyl acrylate, lauryl methacrylate, stearyl methacrylate, cyclotrimethylol propane methylal acrylate, isobornyl methacrylate, tetrahydrofurfuryl methacrylate, isononyl acrylate and SW920 (a long carbon chain monomer of soft and non-sticky vinyl).

Preferably, the catalyst further comprises an auxiliary agent, wherein the auxiliary agent consists of an initiator or an initiator and a reducing agent.

Preferably, the initiator accounts for 0.15-3% of the total mass of the silane modified phosphate monomer and the propenyl monomer; the initiator is any one of potassium persulfate, sodium persulfate, ammonium persulfate, benzoyl peroxide and azodiisobutyronitrile.

Preferably, the reducing agent accounts for 0.5 to 0.6 percent of the total mass of the silane modified phosphate monomer and the propenyl monomer; the reducing agent is any one of sodium bisulphite, sodium sulfate and vitamin C, FF M.

Preferably, the aqueous binder has a molecular weight of 150000 to 800000; more preferably 350000-650000.

The invention also provides a preparation method of the water-based binder for the lithium ion battery, which comprises the following steps:

S1, weighing deionized water, a silane modified phosphate monomer and a propenyl monomer in a reactor, and fully and uniformly stirring;

s2, introducing nitrogen to remove oxygen in the reactor in the stirring process, gradually heating to 40-85 ℃, adding an auxiliary agent solution, and reacting for 5-12h;

And S3, after the reaction is finished, adding an alkaline solution until the pH is 7.0-8.5, and thus obtaining the water-based binder.

Preferably, in step S3, the alkaline solution is any one or more of NaOH, na 2CO3、KOH、Li2CO3, liOH solution.

The invention provides a water-based binder for a lithium ion battery, a preparation method and application thereof, and has the following beneficial effects compared with the prior art:

The water-based binder has high dispersibility, high cohesiveness and high elasticity on the electrode active substances and the conductive substances, can ensure the structural stability of the electrode materials, can buffer the stress generated by the volume expansion and contraction of the active substances, effectively improves the cycle stability and the multiplying power characteristic of the electrode, and has lower impedance of the prepared battery; specifically, the polymer chain segment contains a silane chain segment, has excellent dispersing effect on active substances, and can reduce the problems of layering and the like in a homogenizing process; the adhesive force of phosphate groups and silane groups contained in the polymer chain segments to active substances is high, and the volume change stress of the active substances in the lithium removal and intercalation processes is improved; the cross-linked structure in the polymer chain segment forms a three-dimensional body-shaped structure, which is helpful for maintaining the integrity of the pole piece; the flexible chain segment in the polymer chain segment endows the polymer with high rebound effect and can resist the stress generated by the volume change of the active substance, thereby finally improving the quality of the prepared battery.

Detailed Description

The following examples illustrate embodiments of the present application in detail, so that the implementation process of how the present application can be applied to solve the technical problems and achieve the technical effects can be fully understood and implemented.

Example 1

A preparation method of water-based binder for lithium ion battery comprises the following steps,

The silane modified phosphate monomer (A) is adopted, and the structural formula is as follows:

150g of deionized water, 20g of acrylic acid, 14g of acrylonitrile, 7g of acrylamide, 0.12g of triethylene glycol dimethacrylate and 3.5g of isobornyl methacrylate are added into a reactor, and 6g of silane modified phosphate monomer is added; introducing nitrogen into the reaction system, gradually heating to 75 ℃, and adding 0.45g of sodium persulfate; after 8h of reaction, naOH solution is dripped to adjust the PH to 7, and the water-based adhesive is obtained.

Silicon carbon: conductive carbon black: the aqueous binder was 93:2:5, adding the mixture into a mortar, grinding and blending for 30 minutes, coating the obtained slurry on a copper foil by using a preparation device, drying the copper foil in an oven at 80 ℃ for 12 hours, drying the copper foil in an oven at 110 ℃ for 6 hours, and slicing the copper foil into battery electrodes.

In this example, the electrolyte swelling ratio of the prepared aqueous binder was 17.98%; the peel strength of the prepared battery electrode is 85N/m; the impedance of the prepared half cell was 71 Ω.

Example 2

A preparation method of water-based binder for lithium ion battery comprises the following steps,

The silane modified phosphate monomer (B) is adopted, and the structural formula is as follows:

400g of deionized water, 6g of itaconic acid, 37.5g of methacrylic acid, 10.5g of cyclotrimethylolpropane methylacrylate, 18g of lauryl methacrylate and 3g of silane modified phosphate monomer are added into a reactor; introducing nitrogen into the reaction system, gradually heating to 60 ℃, and adding 0.9g of sodium persulfate and 0.45g of sodium bisulphite; after reacting for 12 hours, dropwise adding NaOH solution to adjust the PH to 7, and obtaining the water-based adhesive.

Silicon carbon: conductive carbon black: the aqueous binder was 93:2:5, adding the mixture into a mortar, grinding and blending for 30 minutes, coating the obtained slurry on a copper foil by using a preparation device, drying the copper foil in an oven at 80 ℃ for 12 hours, drying the copper foil in an oven at 110 ℃ for 6 hours, and slicing the copper foil into battery electrodes.

In this example, the electrolyte swelling ratio of the prepared aqueous binder was 6.5%; the peel strength of the prepared battery electrode is 89N/m; the impedance of the prepared half cell was 64.8Ω.

Example 3

A preparation method of water-based binder for lithium ion battery comprises the following steps,

The silane modified phosphate monomer (C) is adopted, and the structural formula is as follows:

900g of deionized water, 132g of acrylic acid, 40g of butyl methacrylate, 8g of isooctyl methacrylate and 0.4g of N, N-methylene bisacrylamide are added into a reactor, and 20g of silane modified phosphate monomer is added; introducing nitrogen into the reaction system, gradually heating to 80 ℃, and adding 1g of sodium persulfate; after 3 hours of reaction, 0.05g of sodium persulfate is added, then 2 hours of reaction is carried out, and NaOH solution is added dropwise to adjust the PH to 7, thus obtaining the water-based adhesive.

Silicon carbon: conductive carbon black: the aqueous binder was 93:2:5, adding the mixture into a mortar, grinding and blending for 30 minutes, coating the obtained slurry on a copper foil by using a preparation device, drying the copper foil in an oven at 80 ℃ for 12 hours, drying the copper foil in an oven at 110 ℃ for 6 hours, and slicing the copper foil into battery electrodes.

In this example, the electrolyte swelling ratio of the prepared aqueous binder was 6.5%; the peel strength of the prepared battery electrode is 89N/m; the impedance of the prepared half cell was 64.8Ω.

Example 4

A preparation method of water-based binder for lithium ion battery comprises the following steps,

The silane modified phosphate monomer (A) is adopted, and the structural formula is as follows:

1800g of deionized water, 250g of acrylic acid, 80g of tetrahydrofurfuryl methacrylate, 120g of isononyl acrylate, 100g of acrylonitrile and 100g of silane modified phosphate monomer are added into a reactor; introducing nitrogen into the reaction system, gradually heating to 85 ℃, adding 2.5g of azodiisobutyronitrile, reacting for 7 hours, and then dropwise adding LiOH solution to adjust the PH to 7, thus obtaining the water-based adhesive.

Silicon carbon: conductive carbon black: the aqueous binder was 93:2:5, adding the mixture into a mortar, grinding and blending for 30 minutes, coating the obtained slurry on a copper foil by using a preparation device, drying the copper foil in an oven at 80 ℃ for 12 hours, drying the copper foil in an oven at 110 ℃ for 6 hours, and slicing the copper foil into battery electrodes.

In this example, the electrolyte swelling ratio of the prepared aqueous binder was 17.98%; the peel strength of the prepared battery electrode is 73N/m; the impedance of the prepared half cell was 75.6Ω.

Example 5

A preparation method of water-based binder for lithium ion battery comprises the following steps,

The silane modified phosphate monomer (C) is adopted, and the structural formula is as follows:

360g of deionized water, 50g of acrylic acid, 20g of ethyl methacrylate and 16g of 4-tert-butylcyclohexyl acrylate are added into a reactor, and 14g of silane modified phosphate monomer is added; introducing nitrogen into the reaction system, gradually heating to 70 ℃, adding 0.5g of sodium persulfate and 0.5g of vitamin C, reacting for 8 hours, and then dropwise adding KOH solution to adjust the PH to 7, thus obtaining the water-based binder.

Silicon carbon: conductive carbon black: the aqueous binder was 93:2:5, adding the mixture into a mortar, grinding and blending for 30 minutes, coating the obtained slurry on a copper foil by using a preparation device, drying the copper foil in an oven at 80 ℃ for 12 hours, drying the copper foil in an oven at 110 ℃ for 6 hours, and slicing the copper foil into battery electrodes.

In this example, the electrolyte swelling ratio of the prepared aqueous binder was 13.56%; the peel strength of the prepared battery electrode is 93N/m; the impedance of the prepared half cell was 66 Ω.

Comparative example

Commercial aqueous polyacrylic acid product (LA 132) was purchased with a swelling ratio of-1.01% (partial colloidal dissolution); the dissolution loss rate is 5.43%; silicon carbon: conductive carbon black: the aqueous polyacrylic acid binder was 93:2:5, adding the mixture into a mortar, grinding and blending for 30 minutes, coating the obtained slurry on a copper foil by using a preparation device, drying the copper foil in an oven at 80 ℃ for 12 hours, drying the copper foil in an oven at 110 ℃ for 6 hours, and slicing the copper foil into battery electrodes; the peel strength of the prepared electrode is 65N/m; the impedance of the prepared half cell was 129 Ω.

2. Peel strength and electrochemical performance test

And preparing the high-capacity silicon-carbon negative electrode plate by taking the corresponding aqueous binder. The material ratios of the pole pieces prepared in examples 1-5 and comparative examples were configured; the active material is a silicon-carbon anode material, and the theoretical specific capacity is 600mAh/g; the binder is the aqueous binder obtained; the battery slurry was formulated to 40% solids and coated on copper foil using a 150 μm wet film maker. Drying the coated pole piece in an oven at 80 ℃ for 6 hours, and then drying at 110 ℃ for 6 hours; the slurry was tested for peel strength on copper foil. Meanwhile, a part of the coated pole piece is taken and assembled into the CR2032 button battery in a glove box.

Preparation of a soft package battery: positive electrode ratio NCM523 (LiNi 0.5Co0.2Mn0.3O2): SP (conductive carbon black): KS-6 (conductive graphite): PVDF (polyvinylidene fluoride) =95:1.5:1:2.5, NMP (N-methylpyrrolidone) was used as solvent; silicon carbon is proportioned in the cathode: conductive carbon black: CNT (carbon nanotubes): adhesive=90:1.5:0.5:8, calculated as 45% solids of the final slurry. Coating aluminum foil on the positive electrode and copper foil on the negative electrode; and then preparing the soft package battery on a soft package battery preparation line.

The cells were tested for Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS), with an open circuit voltage, a frequency range of 1MHz-0.1Hz, and a voltage amplitude of 5mV. The charge and discharge test was performed on a LANHE CT a blue battery test system at 0.3C magnification with a charge and discharge voltage range of 0.01-1.5V at normal temperature. And testing parameters such as initial charge capacity, coulombic efficiency, multiplying power charge and discharge and the like.

As can be seen from the figure, at wavenumber 1637cm -1, is the c=c stretching vibration region; monomers A, B, C are reactive species that can participate in the reaction; at 1296cm -1 is a telescopic vibration absorption peak of p=o, indicating that the content of different phosphates in the three monomers is different; whereas 840cm -1 and 1040cm -1 are characteristic absorption peaks of Si-O-C, which represent differences in the Si-O-C composition.
